Yes _______ No___X____ Petrobras receives payment of new installments under the Diesel Economic Subvention Program — Rio de Janeiro, September 11, 2026 – Petróleo Brasileiro S.A. - Petrobras informs that it has received the following installments under the Economic Subvention Program for diesel oil commercialization: - R$ 643.8 million, corresponding to diesel sales from June 1 to 15 (Provisional Measure No. 1,358); - R$ 1,923.7 million, corresponding to diesel sales from June 16 to 30 (Provisional Measure No. 1,363). The cumulative total received by Petrobras to date under the diesel, gasoline and LPG subsidy programs amounts to approximately R$ 9.5 billion. www.petrobras.com.br/ir For more information: PETRÓLEO BRASILEIRO S.A. – PETROBRAS | Investor Relations Email: petroinvest@petrobras.com.br/acionistas@petrobras.com.br Av.
